env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.reason: OpenAI provider key; needed unless Anthropic or the existing scoped RELAI provider is configured. OpenAI takes precedence over Anthropic.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.reason: Alternative Anthropic provider key when OpenAI is absent.

env.name: AIRLINE_MODEL_PROVIDER
env.reason: Existing provider selector; relai selects the repository scoped model transport, otherwise normal key-based selection applies.

env.name: RELAI_SESSION_MODEL
env.reason: Required by the existing scoped model transport only when AIRLINE_MODEL_PROVIDER=relai.

env.name: RELAI_API_BASE
env.reason: Model gateway base URL required only by the existing scoped provider; application execution remains local /workspace source.

env.name: RELAI_TEAM_API_KEY
env.reason: Scoped model gateway credential required only when AIRLINE_MODEL_PROVIDER=relai.
